policy: Curated model matrix for LipiCore bank-appliance testing. Do not download every model blindly; run remote inventory first, confirm GPU memory and disk budget, then test one tier at a time.

candidates.test_reason: Current fast-tier baseline from docker-compose; needed for regression comparison.
candidates.risk_notes: Only useful if current server model path exists and vLLM starts cleanly.

candidates.test_reason: Current deep-tier baseline for policy reasoning, document analysis, and citation quality.
candidates.risk_notes: Queue pressure and first-token latency must be measured under concurrency.

candidates.test_reason: Strong long-context candidate for large policies, circular bundles, and report synthesis.
candidates.risk_notes: Large context can exhaust KV cache quickly; benchmark 32K, 64K, and 128K before any 262K claim.

candidates.test_reason: Lower-memory long-context variant to test if the remote GPU cannot serve full precision comfortably.
candidates.risk_notes: FP8 runtime support and quality must be validated on the exact GPU and driver.

candidates.test_reason: Google official docs list Gemma 3 27B with 128K input; useful analyst comparison against current Gemma tier.
candidates.risk_notes: License, model availability, and exact runtime support must be checked before bank packaging.

candidates.test_reason: Potential higher-quality fast tier for staff chat if latency remains acceptable.
candidates.risk_notes: Needs Nepali and not-found discipline tests before replacing current fast tier.

candidates.test_reason: Candidate for concise policy reasoning and drafting; include only after license/runtime validation.
candidates.risk_notes: Exact public model identifier and deployment terms must be verified before download.

candidates.test_reason: Primary LipiCore vision/OCR route for scanned PDFs, document images, table screenshots, and stamp/signature-like detection.
candidates.risk_notes: Must pass OCR/table/Nepali document image benchmarks before bank-facing scanned-document claims.

candidates.test_reason: Fallback vision/OCR route if Qwen3-VL 8B has runtime or quality issues on the target server.
candidates.risk_notes: Older model; benchmark against Qwen3-VL before selecting for bank deployment.

candidates.test_reason: Vision and long-context candidate for scanned PDFs and document images.
candidates.risk_notes: License gating, very large context memory, and local runtime behavior must be validated first.

candidates.test_reason: Multilingual embedding baseline with long input context for English/Nepali retrieval experiments.
candidates.risk_notes: Embedding dimension changes require Qdrant collection migration or a parallel collection.

candidates.test_reason: Multilingual long-context embedding comparison for bank policy and Nepali retrieval.
candidates.risk_notes: Requires trust_remote_code in some setups; validate security posture before airgapped packaging.

candidates.test_reason: Small retrieval candidate for constrained bank appliances.
candidates.risk_notes: Must compare recall@5 and Nepali exact-term retrieval against bge-m3.

candidates.test_reason: Reranking candidate to improve citation precision without changing generation model.
candidates.risk_notes: Reranker latency must be measured under RAG concurrency.
